# Keep intermittent test skips tied to the failing scenario and platform

Entry 714 skips only testXFVirtual on 32-bit Windows debug. The accepted test keeps that condition and adds a separate macOS debug condition with another bug. testSingleVirtual still runs without that skip. Keep bug-linked platform exceptions on the failing task, rather than disabling the entire grouped-sort suite. The comments report CI failures; no CI log or local execution was inspected for this batch.

Scope: mail/base/test.
